# Haki Systems

> AI engineering and intelligent automation consultancy. We design and implement custom AI agents, intelligent workflows and connected business systems for organisations in Zimbabwe, South Africa and internationally.

## About
Haki Systems is a technology consultancy that engineers intelligent systems around real business needs — AI agents, automation workflows and connected infrastructure — rather than generic off-the-shelf software.

## Services
See https://www.hakisystems.co.zw/services for the full list of services, including what we assess, what we build and expected deliverables for each engagement.

## How we work
See https://www.hakisystems.co.zw/how-we-work for our six-step engagement model, from discovery through to ongoing support and maintenance, and our commercial model.

## Contact
Organisations can start a conversation via WhatsApp from https://www.hakisystems.co.zw/contact.
